verdict.rationale: Omnara documents configurable approval gates: users choose which actions need approval, and agents pause to ask for input. Users can also follow progress live and send corrections while an agent works. Phone access is only implied by community comments about using it from a phone and an app with no Android version, not by first-party docs. Also, an approval gate pauses that agent rather than letting it keep working. missing for 10: first-party documentation of mobile approval flows (push notifications, approve/deny from a phone app), Android support, and evidence that other work continues while an approval is pending.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working

citations.quote: You can decide which actions need approval, and agents can pause to ask questions when they need your input.
Follow an agent’s progress live, send a correction while it’s working, or queue up its next task.
using Claude Code from your phone is kind of great
